changelog.summary: Adds a chat-led SaaS finance review with two required Crew roles, validated billing-to-finance handoff, and manual-first activation.

title: Finance Operations Review
description: Coordinate billing exceptions and a sourced finance impact review, with optional accounting close and payables specialists.
setup_prompt: Use Finance Operations Review as a proposal. Inspect this Automation and existing Crews first. Ask only for missing business scope, finance owner, reporting period, currency, authoritative billing and accounting sources, policies, and the review metric. Propose which Crews to reuse or create, their access, a validated billing-to-finance handoff, and a bounded manual first run. After I review the concrete proposal, configure it through Builder tools and verify the result. Selecting this Playbook alone does not connect accounts, create Crews, send messages, issue refunds, pay bills, or enable recurrence.

setup_inputs.label: Entity, reporting period, timezone, and currency
Named owner, refund/contact policy, and review boundaries
Exception or finance metric, definition, and baseline decision
Manual-only or reviewed cadence and timezone

recommended_tools.name: Builder create_crew
recommended_tools.purpose: Create reviewed missing specialists with stable idempotency keys

recommended_tools.name: Builder manage_crew_attachment
recommended_tools.purpose: Pass a bounded validated artifact between authorized Crews

recommended_tools.name: Stripe or Paddle account, or export
recommended_tools.purpose: Provide current authorized subscription, invoice, payment, refund, and dispute records

recommended_tools.name: Accounting ledger or export
recommended_tools.purpose: Ground cash and accounting impact in the customer's source of truth

pulse_focus.label: Finance exception progress
focus_areas: Whether open exceptions are resolved without duplicate or unauthorized actions
Whether billed, collected, and recognized amounts stay distinct and source-linked
review_when: A billing policy changes, exceptions age past the owner's threshold, or a close period completes

outputs: Reviewed Crew roster and source map
Manual two-Crew test run and review decisions
